entity.name: Emre Sokullu
entity.description: I started WebBrain and lead its open-source development and releases. This request is for maintaining the free browser extension.

projects.name: WebBrain
projects.description: WebBrain is an open-source browser agent for Chrome and Firefox. Users can choose a local model or a hosted provider without changing browsers. Mozilla profiled the extension in its Add-ons Developer Spotlight: https://blog.mozilla.org/addons/2026/11/20/developer-spotlight-webbrain/. The public store listings show 2,000 Chrome users and 209 Firefox users as of November 27, 2026. These are separate store counts, not daily active users.

channels.description: Please contact emre@webbrain.one for payment coordination. No banking information is published here.

plans.name: WebBrain extension maintenance
plans.description: One-time support for the free Chrome and Firefox extension: $5,000 to automate release checks for both browsers, including checks that the packages bundle the code they need; $3,000 to test compatibility with a small set of local model runtimes and publish the results; and $2,000 for setup, troubleshooting and contributor release guides. The tests and docs will be public in the WebBrain repository. This does not fund the hosted Compass service or a new product.
